confirmed_goals: Replace scattered household photo folders with self-hosted photo and video management.
confirmed_constraints: Use a disposable synthetic dataset; do not copy personal images.

technical: Photo/video formats, existing storage, required import/export and metadata behavior
architectural: Hosting location, capacity, maintenance owner, backup and recovery path
product: Whether mixed photo/video management is essential, or photo organization/AI assistance is the real priority

records.conditional_decision: Inspect Immich first if the confirmed mixed photo/video and self-hosting goal remains decisive. Prefer inspecting PhotoPrism if the priority changes to an AI-assisted photo workflow and its deployment/data needs are verified. Keep folders if organization alone solves the problem.
records.set_assessment: Same-role alternatives for one household media-management slot; no source-supported complementary connection or incremental value from installing both. Validate one component first to isolate import, recovery and operating burden.

proposals.confirmed_capability: The snapshot description identifies self-hosted photo and video management.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: One candidate media-management service replacing the workflow around scattered folders; current storage integration is unknown.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: A single place for managing the mixed collection may reduce fragmentation; organization and time saved are not measured.
proposals.tradeoff: A hosted service introduces setup, upkeep and recovery responsibilities; requirements and cost are unknown.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Its stated media scope more directly matches the mixed photo/video goal than PhotoPrism's photos description; this does not prove better import or usability.
proposals.preference_reversal: Photo-only AI assistance becomes the priority and PhotoPrism passes the required workflow checks, or keeping folders already meets the need.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Confirm whether videos must be managed together with photos, then verify the chosen version's requirements and documented import/recovery path for one synthetic image and video.

proposals.confirmed_capability: The snapshot describes an AI-powered photos application; specific AI, video and deployment behavior is not established.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Alternative application for the same photo-management slot, conditional on deployment and mixed-media requirements.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: AI assistance may help the photo organization goal if a needed task is supported; that task and benefit are unmeasured.
proposals.tradeoff: Required AI behavior, video coverage, self-hosting and data recovery need verification before assessing operating burden.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Consider before Immich only when a specific AI-assisted photo task outweighs mixed-media scope; folders remain the simpler option if sufficient.
proposals.preference_reversal: Mixed photo/video management remains essential and PhotoPrism cannot verify that requirement.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Name one required AI-assisted photo task and verify its presence and deployment/data requirements in the selected version; report supported, absent or unknown.

ru: Сначала изучите Immich: ваша цель — собрать разрозненные семейные фото и видео в самостоятельно размещаемом сервисе, а описание прямо соответствует этому назначению [H03-E1]. Его возможная роль — один сервис управления коллекцией. Уменьшение разрозненности работы — гипотеза; экономия времени не измерена. Цена перехода — настройка, обслуживание и восстановление данных; требования неизвестны.

PhotoPrism — альтернативное приложение для фотографий с AI [H03-E2]. Изучайте его первым, если важнее конкретная задача организации фото с помощью AI. Польза гипотетическая: нужная функция, видео и самостоятельное размещение не подтверждены. Если видео обязательны и поддержка не подтвердится, предпочтение возвращается к Immich. Если достаточно упорядочить папки, новый сервис может не понадобиться.

Неизвестны форматы, нынешнее хранилище, место размещения, ответственный за обслуживание и резервная копия. Оба приложения претендуют на одну роль; ценность совместной установки не показана. Один пилот позволит связать результат и затраты с выбранным приложением. Совместимость пока неизвестна.

Следующий вопрос: обязательна общая работа с видео и фото или важнее конкретная AI-задача? По документации выбранной версии проверьте требования и путь загрузки/восстановления одного искусственного изображения и видео либо наличие названной AI-функции. Результат — «поддерживается», «не поддерживается» или «неизвестно» по каждому требованию. Затем можно предложить изолированный пилот; личные изображения не нужны. Это варианты для изучения, внедрение и проверки не выполнялись.
en: Inspect Immich first: your goal is to bring scattered household photos and videos into a self-hosted service, and its description directly matches that purpose [H03-E1]. Its potential role is one collection-management service. Reduced fragmentation is a hypothesis; time savings are unmeasured. The trade-off is setup, maintenance and recovery responsibility; requirements are unknown.

PhotoPrism is an alternative AI-powered photos application [H03-E2]. Inspect it first if a specific AI-assisted photo organization task matters more. Benefit is hypothetical: the required feature, video behavior and self-hosting are unverified. If videos remain essential and support cannot be confirmed, preference returns to Immich. If organizing folders is enough, another service may be unnecessary.

Formats, current storage, hosting location, maintenance owner and backup are unknown. Both applications compete for one role; joint installation value has not been shown. One pilot would attribute results and burden to the chosen application. Compatibility remains unknown.

Next question: is joint photo/video management essential, or is a specific AI task more important? Check chosen-version documentation for requirements and an import/recovery path for one synthetic image and video, or the named AI feature. Record supported, unsupported or unknown per requirement. An isolated pilot can then be proposed; personal images are unnecessary. These are investigation options; integration and proposed checks have not been executed.

confirmed_goals: Modernize a Go HTTP API with clearer routing.
confirmed_constraints: Preserve request/response behavior; propose one isolated endpoint regression test.

technical: Existing router/framework, Go version, handler/middleware interfaces, request/response contract
architectural: Whether replacement is limited to routing or needs a broader HTTP framework
product: Affected client behavior, endpoint success criteria and allowable migration effort

records.conditional_decision: Inspect Chi first if clearer routing alone is the problem; inspect Gin first if requirements establish a broader HTTP framework need. Keep the current router if it meets the need and switching adds no demonstrated value.
records.set_assessment: Same-role alternatives for the API's HTTP entry/routing boundary, not a set. One endpoint and one candidate isolate changed behavior and adoption effort.

proposals.confirmed_capability: The snapshot identifies a Go HTTP web framework intended for REST APIs, web applications and microservices. Its performance language is source-reported, not a project measurement.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Alternative framework at the HTTP request-handling boundary; existing handler/middleware integration is unknown.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: A framework approach may meet broader HTTP needs if those needs are established; no missing framework capability is inferred from the Brief.
proposals.tradeoff: Adopting a broader framework may require changes beyond routing; exact interfaces and migration work are unknown.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Prefer investigating Gin over Chi only when broader framework requirements justify the scope; no measured speed advantage is available.
proposals.preference_reversal: Only clearer routing is needed or framework adoption changes the existing endpoint contract unnecessarily.
proposals.decisive_next_check: List the required behavior beyond routing and compare the selected Gin version's interfaces with one existing endpoint before proposing a contract regression test.

proposals.confirmed_capability: The snapshot describes a lightweight composable router for Go HTTP services.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Candidate replacement at the routing boundary of the existing Go HTTP API; exact interface compatibility is unknown.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: Composable routing may organize routes more clearly while keeping the proposed change focused; lower effort is not measured or guaranteed.
proposals.tradeoff: A router may leave broader framework requirements unresolved; middleware/handler adaptation must be checked.
proposals.alternative_comparison: The stated router scope matches clearer routing more directly than Gin's broader framework description, provided additional framework needs are absent.
proposals.preference_reversal: Broader HTTP framework requirements are demonstrated or Chi cannot preserve the selected endpoint contract.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Compare one existing route's handler/middleware requirements with the selected Chi version, then propose a synthetic request/status/header/body regression check.

ru: Сначала изучите Chi, если нужна только более понятная маршрутизация Go HTTP API: описание подтверждает лёгкий составной маршрутизатор [D05-E2]. Предполагаемая роль — слой маршрутов API. Возможная польза — яснее организовать маршруты и ограничить область изменения; это гипотеза, усилия не измерены. Риск — оставить более широкие требования нерешёнными.

Gin — альтернативный Go HTTP framework для REST API, веб-приложений и микросервисов [D05-E1]. Изучайте его первым, если нужен более широкий framework: он мог бы занять границу обработки HTTP-запросов, но такая потребность пока неизвестна; переход может затронуть больше кода. Совместимость обработчиков и middleware у обоих неизвестна. Описание не доказывает совместимость Chi с net/http, а заявленное автором Gin ускорение до 40 раз не измерено для вашего API и не сравнивает его с Chi.

Запросы и ответы требуется сохранить. Неизвестны нынешний маршрутизатор, версии, интерфейсы, потребности клиентов и допустимые усилия. Потребность в framework или нарушение контракта endpoint меняют предпочтение Chi. Если нынешний маршрутизатор достаточен, сохраняйте его. Оба кандидата занимают одну границу; польза совместной установки не показана. Один endpoint ограничит риск и позволит оценить переход.

Следующий вопрос: что нужно сверх маршрутов? Для одного endpoint зафиксируйте контракт и проверьте интерфейсы выбранной версии. Затем предложите изолированный тест: искусственный запрос должен сохранить статус, обязательные заголовки и тело. Выход — таблица совпадений/расхождений и нужные адаптации. Это варианты для изучения; внедрение и тест не выполнялись.
en: Inspect Chi first if clearer Go HTTP API routing is the only need: its description confirms a lightweight composable router [D05-E2]. Its proposed role is the API routing layer. Clearer routes and a focused change are potential benefits, not measured improvements or effort savings. Its trade-off is leaving broader requirements unresolved.

Gin is an alternative Go HTTP framework for REST APIs, web applications and microservices [D05-E1]. Inspect it first if a broader framework is needed: it could occupy the HTTP request-handling boundary, but that need is unknown; adoption may affect more code. Handler/middleware compatibility is unknown for both. The description does not prove Chi's net/http compatibility; Gin's source-reported 40-times speed claim is neither measured for your API nor a comparison with Chi.

Requests and responses must be preserved. Current router, versions, interfaces, client needs and allowable effort are unknown. A framework requirement or endpoint-contract failure reverses the Chi preference. Keep the current router if sufficient. Both candidates occupy one boundary; joint installation benefit is unproven. One endpoint limits risk and makes adoption effort assessable.

Next question: what is needed beyond routing? Freeze one endpoint contract and check chosen-version interfaces. Then propose an isolated test: a synthetic request must preserve status, required headers and body. Output a match/mismatch table and required adaptations. These are investigation options; integration and the test have not been executed.

confirmed_goals: Household budgeting with local-first/offline storage; do not substitute a market trading engine.
confirmed_constraints: Workflow is undocumented; ask focused questions before migration and use synthetic transactions.

technical: Target OS/device, import/export formats, required disconnected behavior, selected-version compatibility
architectural: One-device storage versus cross-device sync, hosting, backup and recovery requirements
product: Household budgeting tasks, need for mobile/web access, acceptable maintenance burden

records.conditional_decision: No unconditional preference. Inspect my-budget first if confirmed need is a desktop budgeting workflow that must work disconnected; inspect BeeCount first if iOS/Android/Web bookkeeping is required; inspect Actual if general local-first personal finance is sufficient. Verify actual offline behavior in every branch.
records.set_assessment: Same-role alternatives for one household finance application; no supported incremental value from duplicate ledgers or installing all three. One synthetic workflow in one candidate makes persistence and data recovery observable.

proposals.confirmed_capability: Catalog description identifies local-first bookkeeping for iOS/Android/Web and named sync options; upstream description remains null.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Alternative household bookkeeping application for multiple named device surfaces; sync is an optional branch, not an activated integration.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: The named device coverage may fit household entry across devices if required; workflow and disconnected behavior are unmeasured.
proposals.tradeoff: If sync is required, its setup and recovery add questions; no provider or sync is enabled by this recommendation.
proposals.alternative_comparison: More explicit device coverage than Actual's general local-first description; my-budget has more explicit offline Electron positioning.
proposals.preference_reversal: Only a disconnected desktop workflow is needed or BeeCount fails the selected-device persistence/recovery requirements.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Confirm required devices and sync, then check selected-version prerequisites and propose disconnected synthetic-entry/reopen/export checks on the required device.

proposals.confirmed_capability: Upstream description identifies a local-first personal finance application; catalog description remains null.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Alternative application for one household finance workflow; device and storage/deployment placement need clarification.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: Personal finance focus may match household budgeting without selecting a trading engine; exact tasks and local behavior need verification.
proposals.tradeoff: A general local-first description leaves offline behavior, devices and recovery unknown, so initial documentation/workflow validation is needed.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Investigate if general local-first personal finance is the requirement; source evidence cannot rank it above BeeCount's device coverage or my-budget's offline claim.
proposals.preference_reversal: A required device or disconnected task fails, or another candidate verifies those requirements with less acceptable operating burden.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Name the required budgeting task/device and verify chosen-version support; propose creating and reopening synthetic transactions disconnected with checked totals and recovery output.

proposals.confirmed_capability: Catalog description identifies an offline cross-platform budgeting solution built with Electron; upstream description and release date remain null.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Alternative budgeting application for a conditional desktop/disconnected workflow; platform compatibility is unknown.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: The stated offline budgeting scope may fit entry without a connection; actual disconnected persistence/recovery remains unverified.
proposals.tradeoff: Electron/platform prerequisites and maintenance/release evidence need checking. The old observed commit alone neither establishes operability nor rejects the option.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Its description is more explicit about offline operation than BeeCount/Actual's local-first positioning, but it does not prove better offline behavior.
proposals.preference_reversal: Mobile/web or sync becomes essential, or selected-version compatibility, disconnected behavior or recovery fails.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Confirm desktop OS and mandatory disconnected tasks; verify the chosen version's support and propose synthetic create/reopen/export/recovery checks with expected totals.

ru: Для домашнего бюджета пока нельзя выбрать победителя: неизвестны устройство и обязательные действия без сети. Если нужен настольный бюджет без подключения, сначала изучите my-budget: каталог прямо описывает offline-приложение на Electron [H15-E3]. Его роль — одно приложение бюджета; возможная польза — вести учёт без подключения. Это гипотеза: фактическая работа, совместимость и восстановление неизвестны. Требования платформы и поддержку версии нужно проверить; обязательный мобильный/web-доступ или провал offline-проверки меняют выбор.

BeeCount описан как local-first учёт на iOS/Android/Web с вариантами синхронизации [H15-E1]. Для обязательного ввода на этих устройствах это более явное соответствие, чем описание Actual или настольная роль my-budget. Польза нескольких устройств гипотетическая; нужная синхронизация добавит настройку и восстановление. Если достаточно одного компьютера без сети, предпочтение исчезает. Синхронизация не включается.

Actual — local-first приложение личных финансов [H15-E2], альтернатива для той же роли домашнего бюджета. Возможное соответствие общим задачам финансов — гипотеза; описание не подтверждает нужные устройства, функции или offline-поведение. Выберите другой вариант, если обязательное действие не поддерживается. Local-first не гарантирует работу без сети. Для my-budget commit в снимке датирован 2022-07-27, release неизвестен: это повод проверить поддержку, а не отвергнуть приложение.

Неизвестны задачи бюджета, форматы обмена и резервная копия. Все три занимают одну роль; совместная установка не обоснована. Один пилот позволит связать результат с выбранным приложением. Следующий вопрос: какие устройства обязательны; без сети нужен просмотр или также ввод и повторное открытие? После проверки требований версии предложите искусственные операции с известной суммой: ввод без сети, закрытие/открытие, сверка, документированные выгрузка/восстановление. Выход — поддерживается/не поддерживается/неизвестно по каждому действию. При неудаче сохраните текущий учёт и тестовые данные. Это варианты для изучения; перенос реальных финансов и пилот не выполнялись.
en: No household-budget winner is justified yet: required devices and disconnected tasks are unknown. If disconnected desktop budgeting is required, inspect my-budget first: the catalog explicitly describes an offline Electron application [H15-E3]. Its role is one budgeting application; disconnected bookkeeping is a hypothetical benefit. Actual behavior, compatibility and recovery are unknown. Check platform prerequisites and version support; required mobile/web access or a failed offline check reverses preference.

BeeCount is described as local-first bookkeeping on iOS/Android/Web with sync options [H15-E1]. Required entry on those devices is a clearer fit than Actual’s description or my-budget’s proposed desktop role. Cross-device benefit is hypothetical; required sync adds setup/recovery work. If one disconnected computer suffices, the preference disappears. Sync is not enabled.

Actual is a local-first personal finance application [H15-E2], an alternative for the same household-budget role. General finance fit is hypothetical; required devices, features and offline behavior are unverified. Reverse preference if a mandatory task fails. Local-first does not guarantee disconnected operation. For my-budget, the snapshot commit is dated 2022-07-27 and release is unknown: check support rather than rejecting it.

Budget tasks, exchange formats and backup are unknown. All three occupy one role; joint installation is unsupported. One pilot would attribute results to one application. Next question: which devices are mandatory; must disconnected use support viewing only, or entry/reopening too? After checking version requirements, propose synthetic transactions with a known total: disconnected entry, close/reopen, reconciliation, documented export/recovery. Output supported/unsupported/unknown per task. On failure retain current bookkeeping and test data. These are investigation options; real-finance migration and the pilot have not been executed.

confirmed_goals: Store telemetry metrics/time series and compare specialized engines with analytical databases.
confirmed_constraints: Synthetic telemetry context; preserve one evidence basis, unknowns, prerequisites and proposed-only status in RU/EN.

technical: Event schema, required window aggregates, ingest/query interfaces, rate and retention
architectural: Existing database, whether PostgreSQL is used, permission to install extensions, hosting and recovery requirements
product: Required latency, correctness expectations, duplicate/late-event rules and acceptable operating burden

records.conditional_decision: Inspect InfluxDB first if metrics/events define the required storage role; consider QuestDB for a verified general time-series workload. Prefer investigating TimescaleDB only if an existing suitable PostgreSQL environment and extension permission are confirmed. Without workload/current-storage facts no adoption winner is justified.
records.set_assessment: Same-role alternatives for one telemetry storage boundary. No source-supported division of work, cross-database connection or benefit from installing all three. One synthetic ingest/query slice isolates correctness and adoption burden.

proposals.confirmed_capability: The snapshot identifies a datastore for metrics, events and real-time analytics; scale and latency are not measured here.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Candidate telemetry datastore behind the service's ingest/query boundary; connection to current storage is unknown.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: Metrics/events positioning may align with the known service purpose if required queries and correctness can be supported.
proposals.tradeoff: Adoption requires verified ingest/query adaptation, hosting and recovery; effort and comparative operating cost are unknown.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Its explicit metrics/events scope is the first inspection match, while QuestDB's description is broader time-series scope; no superiority in load/cost is established.
proposals.preference_reversal: It fails required aggregates or duplicate/late-event rules, or suitable existing PostgreSQL with extension permission makes the TimescaleDB path viable.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Define one event schema, window aggregate and duplicate/late-event rule; check selected-version interfaces and propose a synthetic ingest/query correctness slice.

proposals.confirmed_capability: The snapshot identifies a time-series database for real-time analytics packaged as a Postgres extension; its performance wording is not a measurement.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Conditional extension in an existing suitable PostgreSQL storage environment; that environment and permission are not confirmed.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: If PostgreSQL already exists and extensions are allowed, an extension route may reuse part of the existing storage operation; compatibility, cost and effort are unmeasured.
proposals.tradeoff: Requires compatible PostgreSQL and extension authorization/support, plus workload and recovery validation; adding PostgreSQL solely for this option has no established benefit.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Investigate before the other datastore alternatives only when existing PostgreSQL and permission are confirmed; otherwise its proposed placement lacks a prerequisite.
proposals.preference_reversal: PostgreSQL is absent/incompatible, extensions are forbidden, or required workload behavior fails.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Confirm existing PostgreSQL version and extension permission; output confirmed/absent/unknown and allowed/forbidden/unknown before any extension pilot.

proposals.confirmed_capability: The snapshot identifies an open-source time-series database; performance is not measured here.
proposals.proposed_architectural_role: Alternative datastore at the same telemetry ingest/query boundary; API and existing architecture compatibility are unknown.
proposals.expected_project_benefit_hypothesis: Time-series focus may fit time-window analysis if selected-version queries and correctness match the workload.
proposals.tradeoff: An alternative storage engine needs verified ingestion/query adaptation and operating/recovery requirements; load and cost differences are unknown.
proposals.alternative_comparison: Consider over InfluxDB if the actual query/correctness slice fits QuestDB better; source descriptions alone do not establish this. TimescaleDB needs its separate PostgreSQL prerequisite.
proposals.preference_reversal: Required queries or event rules fail, or another candidate/current storage verifies the same need with acceptable burden.
proposals.decisive_next_check: Check the required aggregate and duplicate/late-event rules against selected-version behavior, then propose the same synthetic ingest/query slice.

ru: Начните с изучения InfluxDB, если главное — хранить метрики и события: описание прямо совпадает с этой задачей [H11-E1]. Его предполагаемая роль — хранилище за границей приёма данных и запросов. Соответствие нужной аналитике — гипотеза; интерфейсы, эксплуатация и восстановление неизвестны. Победителя для внедрения пока выбрать нельзя: Brief не определяет запросы и нынешнюю базу.

QuestDB описан как база временных рядов [H11-E3], альтернатива на той же границе. Возможная польза — анализ временных окон, если обязательные запросы поддерживаются; это гипотеза. Предпочтите его InfluxDB, если одинаковая проверка покажет лучшее соответствие запросам и правилам событий. Описание этого не доказывает; адаптация интерфейсов и обслуживание неизвестны. Провал обязательного сценария меняет предпочтение любого кандидата.

TimescaleDB — база временных рядов в форме расширения Postgres [H11-E2]. Изучайте его первым только при подтверждённых существующем совместимом PostgreSQL и разрешении на расширения. Тогда он мог бы использовать существующее хранилище и часть его эксплуатации; выгода и совместимость неизвестны. Brief не подтверждает PostgreSQL. Отсутствие, несовместимая версия, запрет расширений или провал сценария меняют выбор.

Неизвестны схема, частота записи, срок хранения, агрегаты, допустимая задержка и правила дубликатов/поздних событий. Скорость, нагрузка и стоимость не сравнивались. Если нынешняя база достаточна, сохраняйте её. Все три — альтернативы одному хранилищу; польза совместной установки не показана. Один пилот позволит связать результат с движком.

Следующий вопрос: есть ли PostgreSQL и разрешены ли расширения; какой оконный агрегат и правила событий обязательны? Зафиксируйте подтверждено/отсутствует/неизвестно и разрешено/запрещено/неизвестно. Проверьте документацию версии, затем предложите искусственные события с известным агрегатом, дубликатом и поздним событием. Выход — ожидаемые/полученные значения, обработка каждого события и сохранность после перезапуска. При несовпадении сохраните нынешнюю базу и тестовые данные. Это варианты для изучения; подключение, миграция и проверки не выполнялись.
en: Inspect InfluxDB first if metrics/events are the priority: its description directly matches that task [H11-E1]. Its proposed role is storage behind ingestion and queries. Fit to required analytics is hypothetical; interfaces, operation and recovery are unknown. No adoption winner is justified: the Brief does not define queries or current storage.

QuestDB is described as a time-series database [H11-E3], an alternative at the same boundary. Time-window analysis is a potential benefit if required queries are supported, not an observed result. Prefer it over InfluxDB if the same check shows better query/event-rule fit. Descriptions do not prove that; interface adaptation and upkeep are unknown. Failure of a mandatory scenario reverses any candidate preference.

TimescaleDB is a time-series database packaged as a Postgres extension [H11-E2]. Inspect it first only with confirmed existing compatible PostgreSQL and extension permission. It could reuse existing storage and part of its operation; benefit and compatibility are unknown. The Brief does not establish PostgreSQL. Absence, incompatible versions, forbidden extensions or workload failure reverses preference.

Schema, write rate, retention, aggregates, acceptable latency and duplicate/late-event rules are unknown. Speed, load and cost were not compared. Keep current storage if sufficient. All three are alternatives for one datastore; joint installation value is unproven. One pilot attributes results to an engine.

Next question: is PostgreSQL present and are extensions allowed; which window aggregate and event rules are mandatory? Record confirmed/absent/unknown and allowed/forbidden/unknown. Check version documentation, then propose synthetic events with a known aggregate, duplicate and late event. Output expected/observed values, handling per event and restart persistence. On mismatch retain current storage and test data. These are investigation options; connection, migration and checks have not been executed.

records.synthetic_context: A synthetic telemetry service needs metrics/time-series storage. Produce paired RU/EN recommendations with the same evidence, unknowns, prerequisites and proposed-only execution status.
